requirements.description: Synchronous reset clears the PC, running, done and every lane register file
The core stays idle until start is pulsed, then fetches and executes from instruction address 0
Each lane computes the 4-element dot product of its a and b vectors with 32-bit wraparound matching the reference model
Each lane stores its result to its own dmem bank at offset 8, leaving other lanes and input words untouched
done asserts after EXIT and stays asserted while the core is halted
MOVI/MOV/ADD/SUB/MUL and the SETPLT true path produce the directed microtest results
BRA skips the instructions between the branch and its target, and the SETPLT false path yields 0
